checked: Royce p. 856: June 5, 1872, Stat. L. XVII, 228, confirms the amended Osage reserve bounded by the 96th meridian, the Creek country and Arkansas river, and the Kansas line, with the Kansa settlement proviso (160 acres a member, paid for by the Kansa). Matches.

Irby (597 F.3d 1117) cites the Act as Act of June 5, 1872, ch. 310, 17 Stat. 228, 'An Act to Confirm to the Great and Little Osage Indians a Reservation in the Indian Territory'. Citation and aka match; the ruling went against the Nation and is in today, not breaches.
